## 1. Verdict
Honest fixture, exactly what its header claims: hand-authored shapes ffmpeg cannot emit — set-level duration-based SegmentTemplate (timescale 900000, @duration 4500000), `ContentProtection` with `cenc:default_KID`, three BaseURL levels (MPD `https://cdn.example/vod/` + Period `p0/` + Rep `hi/`), xml:lang, a Role descriptor, and a SegmentBase subtitle representation. Consumed by: `mpd.rs:2281` (`hand_static_fixture_full_surface` — asserts scheme `urn:mpeg:dash:mp4protection:2011`, value `cenc`, `default_kid` recorded verbatim), `resolve.rs:1087` (multi-level BaseURL folding over every representation), and `dash/fuzz.rs` (committed-fixture sweep). Math verified: Period PT2M × 900000 = 108 000 000 ticks / 4 500 000 = exactly 24 segments per video representation.

## 2. What actually works (verified)
— rg consumer scan (3 files above); parser test asserts the CENC triple verbatim; `#EXTINF`-class arithmetic verified by hand (24 exact segments, no remainder).
